paths.description: Homepage/content hub: primary discovery, search entry, preferences, responsive layout and global delivery/security.
Video listing template representing sorted and paginated catalogue pages.
Category index archetype representing taxonomy navigation.
Photo listing archetype, distinct portrait-card media template.
Search journey and result state using a representative query.
Video detail/playback archetype: primary content, metadata, media accessibility and mobile reflow.
HTTP failure/recovery state using a guaranteed missing route.
Linked German locale used to test translated UI and locale-aware data.

findings.summary: Theme is fixed rather than preference-aware
findings.evidence: Light and dark emulation produced byte-identical 158,720-byte screenshots; computed color-scheme is normal and the body remains rgb(17, 5, 37).
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() so browser UI and surfaces follow the user preference.

findings.summary: Route and state changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition rules and the captured menu interaction has no coherent transition.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful route and state changes, while respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-position feedback
findings.evidence: The mobile homepage is 14,431px tall, but screenshots and DOM inspection show no sticky/shrinking header, progress indicator, or scroll affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-progress or scroll-state-aware header treatment on long listings.

findings.summary: Menus and overlays use manually wired legacy positioning
findings.evidence: Navigation uses non-semantic div controls and Bootstrap-style collapse/dropdown markup; no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try rules were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks for menus that must remain attached near viewport edges.

findings.summary: Transient UI relies on ad-hoc legacy modal and collapse markup
findings.evidence: The login surface is an injected div role=dialog with aria-hidden=true while visible, no aria-modal, and manual backdrop; navigation toggles are non-focusable divs.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace ad-hoc overlays with dialog/popover and declarative commands/light-dismiss; expose menu toggles as buttons.

findings.summary: Reusable card layouts adapt only at the viewport level
findings.evidence: Cards change from four columns to one between captures, but stylesheet inspection found no container queries, so reused components cannot respond to their actual container.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable grids/cards container-type and use size-aware @container rules with existing viewport rules as fallback.

findings.summary: Keyboard and touch affordances are incomplete
findings.evidence: Programmatic focus reported outline none on sampled controls; hamburger controls are tabindex=-1 divs, search/filter buttons lack names, and Lighthouse found 16px-high footer targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic buttons, visible :focus-visible styles, non-hover fallbacks, and at least 24x24 CSS-pixel targets with adequate spacing.

findings.summary: Not-found requests end in a dead-end server page
findings.evidence: A representative missing route correctly returned 404 but rendered only “404 Not Found / nginx” with no explanation, search, home link, or recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 with concise context, search, Home and back actions while preserving the 404 status.

findings.summary: Lab LCP misses the good threshold
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.0s and TTI 5.6s, although the CDP trace measured LCP 1.69s and only 11.51ms TBT; the slower repeat puts LCP above the 2.5s good threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP thumbnail, reduce document latency, and remeasure across multiple mobile runs and field data.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is delayed by document latency and parser-inserted assets
findings.evidence: HAR measured a 1.19s document and parser-inserted CSS plus three synchronous classic scripts; Lighthouse reported a 984ms critical chain and missing fetchpriority on the LCP image.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP request, defer non-critical classic scripts, shorten document latency, and keep cache headers useful.

findings.summary: Analytics scripts dominate transferred JavaScript
findings.evidence: Scripts transfer 496,275 bytes; Google Tag Manager/gtag and Yandex account for roughly 482KB across overlapping analytics stacks, far more than the 55KB site bundle.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics stacks, conditionally load the minimum measurement code after consent, and defer it from the critical path.

findings.summary: Core controls and login fields lack accessible names/labels
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found three unnamed icon buttons; the search button has no label, login inputs rely on placeholders, and the visible modal remains aria-hidden=true.
findings.suggestedFix: Add durable labels/names, correct dialog state, and semantic buttons; validate with the accessibility tree and keyboard use.

findings.summary: Two text surfaces fail WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 3.74:1 for age-verification subtext and 2.58:1 for footer copyright text, below the 4.5:1 normal-text threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground or surface tokens to reach at least 4.5:1 and retest all states.

findings.summary: Landmarks and focus behavior are not robust
findings.evidence: No header/nav/main/footer landmarks were present, Lighthouse found no main landmark, focused controls computed to outline none, and the injected modal is focused while aria-hidden=true.
findings.suggestedFix: Add semantic landmarks, logical headings, managed dialog focus, and visible :focus-visible treatment.

findings.summary: Small targets and missing media equivalents limit comparable use
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found footer links only 16px high with inadequate spacing; the video detail exposes no track/caption metadata in its player surface. Mobile reflow itself had no overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target size/spacing and provide captions or equivalent transcripts for video content; retain current reflow behavior.

findings.summary: Image delivery uses legacy, non-responsive assets
findings.evidence: The document has valid doctype/UTF-8, but 71 of 72 images use legacy formats, 70 lack srcset, six lack dimensions, and two lack alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep valid document metadata, add dimensions/srcset/sizes, and deliver AVIF/WebP where beneficial with fallback.

findings.summary: The page is excluded from BFCache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported five BFCache failure reasons, including actionable Cache-Control: no-store after cookie modification and WebSocket use; browser Issues also logged cookie problems.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid no-store on non-sensitive public pages, close/unload unnecessary WebSockets, and retest BFCache navigation.

findings.summary: robots.txt advertises a sitemap on a different hostname
findings.evidence: The audited host serves a valid local sitemap index, but robots.txt declares Sitemap: https://www.sexvid.xxx/sitemap.xml instead of the canonical www.sexvid1.com host.
findings.suggestedFix: Align robots.txt, canonical URLs, and sitemap locations to one intended production hostname and redirect alternates consistently.

findings.summary: Video entities lack VideoObject structured data
findings.evidence: The detail page has useful Open Graph video metadata but no JSON-LD; the homepage only exposes WebSite/SearchAction microdata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching visible title, description, thumbnail, duration, upload date, and content URL.

findings.summary: Transport hardening and cookie flags are incomplete
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent; five first-party cookies are not Secure and PHPSESSID is not HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, a restrictive CSP, nosniff, and Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookie attributes appropriate to each cookie.

findings.summary: Tracking starts before consent and is disproportionate
findings.evidence: Load contacted six third-party origins and Google Analytics, GTM, and Yandex; 57 of 61 requests and 822,421 of 877,442 transferred bytes were classified third-party by origin.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise analytics, load it only after informed consent where required, batch necessary events, and document retention/purposes.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only and lacks passkey support
findings.evidence: No permission prompt fired on load, but source probes found no WebAuthn/credential integration; the login modal exposes only username and password.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration/authentication and retain a recovery path; continue requesting permissions only in context.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are mostly absent
findings.evidence: Headers include X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN, but HSTS, CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, CSP with frame-ancestors and Trusted Types where applicable, strict Referrer-Policy, and least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: HTTP failure state has no recovery path
findings.evidence: The tested missing URL returns a correct 404 but only the stock nginx page, with no branded shell, search, retry, back, or home action.
findings.suggestedFix: Render a resilient branded error template with retry/search/navigation while preserving status semantics.

findings.summary: The German locale remains partly English and uses English number conventions
findings.evidence: German headings and relative dates are translated, but the age-verification block and video titles remain English and view counts render as “1533.1M” rather than locale-appropriate German formatting.
findings.suggestedFix: Externalise all strings and format counts/durations with Intl.NumberFormat/Intl.RelativeTimeFormat for the active locale.

findings.summary: Privacy claim conflicts with immediate tracking behavior
findings.evidence: The page says “we don’t store personal data” beside age verification, while the initial load sets persistent GA/Yandex identifiers and sends analytics before any consent control is shown.
findings.suggestedFix: Use precise, scoped privacy copy and obtain informed consent before non-essential tracking; avoid absolute claims contradicted by analytics behavior.

findings.summary: Login errors are visual-only and fields lack validation semantics
findings.evidence: Submitting an empty login shows “The field is required” twice, but inputs have no label, required or aria-invalid and error nodes have no role/aria-live.
findings.suggestedFix: Add labels, required/aria-invalid, programmatic error associations and an aria-live summary, validating after interaction.

findings.summary: Login fields omit autofill tokens
findings.evidence: The username/password inputs have no labels or autocomplete values, preventing reliable username/current-password autofill and password-manager assistance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add labelled fields with autocomplete=username and autocomplete=current-password; use appropriate tokens for signup fields.

findings.summary: Account sign-in uses a fragile legacy modal and password-only flow
findings.evidence: The modal is displayed with aria-hidden=true, forces remember_me=1 in a hidden field, lacks autocomplete, and exposes no passkey option.
findings.suggestedFix: Use an accessible dialog, make session persistence explicit, add autofill and passkeys, and preserve clear recovery/cancellation.

findings.summary: Image assets are not modern or responsive
findings.evidence: Image audit found 71 legacy-format images, 70 without srcset, six without dimensions, and one SVG reported oversized relative to display.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve right-sized AVIF/WebP variants with srcset/sizes, preserve SVG where appropriate, and reserve dimensions.

findings.summary: Non-essential analytics performs substantial background work
findings.evidence: The initial page loads overlapping GTM/gtag, Google Analytics and Yandex stacks, including cookie-sync redirects and background collection, despite no user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate stacks, defer allowed analytics until consent/idle, batch events, and stop session-wide collection that lacks user value.

findings.summary: Third-party code consumes most transferred bytes before media playback
findings.evidence: HAR classified 822KB of an 877KB initial load as third-party-origin traffic; analytics scripts are the largest resources, while the user has not started video.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, gate analytics, and prioritise user-requested media over trackers.

taskList.title: Make analytics consent-first, minimal, and consistent with the privacy copy
Rebuild core controls, navigation, landmarks, focus, and dialogs with accessible semantics
Deploy defensive headers and correct security-sensitive cookie attributes
Replace the stock 404 with a useful recovery experience
Make login humane, autofill-friendly, explicit about persistence, and passkey-capable
Provide captions or equivalent media text and enlarge undersized touch targets
Optimise responsive images and reserve their layout space
Improve LCP discovery, document latency, and critical resource sequencing
Complete German localisation and locale-aware number formatting
Align robots and sitemap hosts and add VideoObject structured data
Restore BFCache eligibility where public-page caching permits it
Adopt preference-aware theming and progressively enhance long-page navigation and reusable components
